messages:
Aria: Quick sync — FinBank wants a short POC. They asked for Hosted API keys for devs, a Dedicated pool for load tests, and a Private/VPC option for security review. Need a clear invite + least-privilege role plan. Who owns what?
Luis: I can own Hosted keys + invite flow. For Dedicated we'll need a pool request (reservation) and sizing.
Marta: I can provision a dedicated pool on staging. Need customer CIDR and their peering contact. ETA ~48h after we get CIDR + SAML metadata.
Priya: Security asks: separation of duties and audit tail. Recommend roles: viewer, developer, infra-admin (least privilege by default). Also will need to confirm KMS/HSM options for Private.
Finn (FinBank): I can share CIDR and SSO metadata. We prefer ephemeral API keys for devs. How do invites handle role assignment when using SSO?
Luis: We support SSO (SAML). Invites map SAML groups to workspace roles. Ephemeral keys: we can create time-bound keys via console (TTL). I'll draft a role snippet.
Aria: Can you paste that snippet here? Also quick pricing q: they want to run ~3k concurrent tokens/day for a week of load tests — what Dedicated tier?
Luis: ```json
{"assignments": [{"email":"alice@finbank.com","role":"developer","ttl":"72h"},{"group":"finbank-infra","role":"infra-admin"}]}
```
Marta: For 3k tokens/day sustained burst, small Dedicated pool (2x GPU equiv) should be fine. I'll confirm exact instance shape but ballpark ETA after we size tests. Quote side goes via Sales.
Priya: For SSO mapping please ensure the SAML attribute for groups is forwarded. Also require audit log retention for 90 days for their compliance team. I'll add KMS questions to the security questionnaire.
Aria: I'll send them the invite flow doc + SAML mapping guide. @Finn can you confirm SSO metadata + CIDR by EOD?
Finn (FinBank): :thumbsup: I'll get SSO metadata and CIDR to you by EOD. Also can you share NDA + security questionnaire link?
Aria: Sending NDA and the security questionnaire link now. We'll also spin up Hosted sandbox API keys for their devs immediately. @Luis can you create 5 ephemeral keys?
ops-bot: dedicated-pool-provisioner: pool-request-1955 created, status: pending-approval
Luis: Done — created 5 ephemeral keys and sent via secure share to the contact on file. Also opened PO request for the Dedicated pool (id: pool-request-1955).
Marta: Once CIDR and SSO metadata are in I'll trigger VPC peering and set up route tables. Ping me the contact email and desired peering window.
Priya: Added checklist items to security tracker: SAML group mapping, KMS integration, audit retention. Tagging security-ops for a quick review.
Aria: Great — tracking everything in the POC doc. Next sync tomorrow 10am PT. /cc @Luis @Marta
